privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile app at the airport.
privacy.p1:
We may collect the following types of information when you use our app:
 
• Personal Identification Information: Name, email address, phone number, flight details, and any other data you provide.
• Usage Data: Information about how you use our app, including device information, log data, and location data.
• Cookies: Small files stored on your device to enhance user experience.
privacy.p2:
We use your information for the following purposes:
 
• To provide services such as flight updates, boarding information, and airport navigation.
• To personalize your experience with relevant offers and notifications.
• To improve app performance and functionality.
• To comply with legal obligations.
privacy.p3:
We do not share your personal information with third parties, except:
 
• With service providers that help operate the app and provide airport services.
• For legal reasons, if required by law or regulation, or to protect our rights and safety.
privacy.p4: We implement a variety of security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption and access controls. However, no system is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.p5:
You have the right to:
 
• Access and update your personal data.
• Request the deletion of your personal data.
• Opt-out of marketing communications.
• Withdraw consent at any time, where applicable.
privacy.p6: Our app may collect location data to provide services like real-time airport navigation. You can opt out of location tracking through your device settings.
privacy.p7: Our app may contain links to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these sites.
privacy.p8: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy. We will notify users of significant changes by updating the policy within the app.
privacy.p9:
If you have any questions or concerns about our Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
• Email: HamadinterAirport@gmail.com
• Phone: +974 9854 6552 / +974 7894 5687
